boundary_note: Bounded first pass for the frozen Barbourville record (September 19, 1861) in Operations in Eastern Kentucky [September-December 1861]. Zollicoffer's advance to Cumberland Ford is context. Campaign-wide marches, returns, reinforcements and multi-action loss totals are context; they are not assigned to one record or added across records. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The frozen force field gives the Home Guard about 300 and Battle's detachment about 800; the live field reads US 300 and CS 800. Zollicoffer reports that an advanced force about 800 strong found about 300 of the enemy at Barbourville.
claims.rationale: The CWSAC figures match Zollicoffer's report; its basis is not stated and the match is not corroboration. No Union report was inspected. None is adopted as a matched opening strength.

open_questions: No Union report of the action appears in the inspected passages; Battle's own report, the home guard's side, returns and maps remain deferred. No nineteenth-century history covering the action was selected; this is a two-report or two-family first pass.

NPS/CWSAC (the live battle page and the frozen Arnold rows) is one family. Zollicoffer's September 19 and October 20-26, 1861 reports are one family of interested Confederate accounts (the same author for Barbourville and Camp Wildcat). Official Records volumes are shared containers, not additional witnesses. Report dates are not event times or proof of contemporary knowledge.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
